package service

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"strings"
)

// scenario for service_returns_preformatted_client_message: Services that return final client-facing message strings instead of typed domain errors.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
type RegistrationService struct {
	repo UserRepository
}

var (
	ErrEmailTaken = errors.New("This email address is already registered. Please use a different email or try logging in.")
	ErrWeakPass   = errors.New("Password must be at least 8 characters and include a number and a special character.")
)

func (s *RegistrationService) SignUp(ctx context.Context, email, password string) error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(email) == "" {
		return errors.New("Email address is required.")
	}
	if len(password) < 8 {
		return ErrWeakPass
	}
	exists, err := s.repo.EmailExists(ctx, email)
	if err != nil {
		return errors.New("We encountered a problem creating your account. Please try again later.")
	}
	if exists {
		return ErrEmailTaken
	}
	return s.repo.Insert(ctx, email, password)
}

type UserRepository interface {
	EmailExists(ctx context.Context, email string) (bool, error)
	Insert(ctx context.Context, email, password string) error
}
